# Chronoverse Capital

> An independent, English-language platform for original downloadable software, supported by editorial research on economics, finance and history. The software catalog is in pre-launch; no applications are released yet.

Canonical site: [Chronoverse Capital](https://chronoversecapital.com/)

## Public destinations

- [Applications](https://apps.chronoversecapital.com/)

- [Research](https://chronoversecapital.com/reports)
- [Methodology](https://chronoversecapital.com/methodology)
- [Data Sources](https://chronoversecapital.com/data-sources)
- [Freshness & Availability](https://chronoversecapital.com/freshness)
- [About](https://chronoversecapital.com/about)
- [Contact](https://chronoversecapital.com/contact)
- [Frequently Asked Questions](https://chronoversecapital.com/faq)
- [Privacy Policy](https://chronoversecapital.com/privacy-policy)
- [Cookie Policy](https://chronoversecapital.com/cookie-policy)
- [Purchase and Refund Information](https://chronoversecapital.com/refund-policy)
- [Terms of Service](https://chronoversecapital.com/terms-of-service)

The apps catalog is separate from the existing Gumroad storefront at https://shop.chronoversecapital.com/. Future eligible releases will link to verified Gumroad product pages; no software checkout, subscriptions or licensing are currently implemented here.

Public information is analytical and informational, not personalized financial advice.
